args: if [ -f "$HOME/.local/bin/env" ]; then . "$HOME/.local/bin/env"; fi; uv_path="$(command -v uv || true)"; if [ -z "$uv_path" ]; then echo 'uv was not found on PATH' >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'lsof was not found on PATH' >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! lsof -nP -iTCP:24225 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$uv_path" run --with serena-agent serena start-project-server >/tmp/serena-project-server.log 2>&1 & for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do if lsof -nP -iTCP:24225 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if ! lsof -nP -iTCP:24225 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Serena ProjectServer did not start on port 24225; see /tmp/serena-project-server.log' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; exec "$uv_path" run --with serena-agent serena start-mcp-server --context vscode --add-mode query-projects --project "$HOME/code/fiji/fiji-llm"
